finding.text: There is no `requirements.md` at the top of this task folder (mastermind-session-truth/), only `brief-common.md` and one per sub-folder (`score-endings/requirements.md`, `truth/requirements.md`). I judged the diff against `score-endings/requirements.md`, the brief it matches. A fresh agent could not find the owner's ask for this change from the top folder, so link or copy it there.

The code change is small and correct. `core/Task/Task.js:390` now counts a turn Prompt marked `no_action` as finished, not open. `Prompt.js:128` already scores such a turn 1, so tally and score now agree. `Session.test.mjs:133` asserts `tally().open === 0`, and both `Session.test.mjs` and `completion.test.mjs` pass when I ran them.

`completion.test.mjs` has no check for the new `no_action` branch in `tally()`. The one assertion is in `Session.test.mjs` and goes through a replayed turn. Add a one-line check beside the other tally checks in `core/Task/completion.test.mjs`, since `tally()` is a Task method.

The `SessionFolders` readme line (`core/Session/readme.md:39`) now documents `.url(id)` and `url_in`. Both already exist at `SessionFolders.mjs:173` and `:179`, with callers such as `Servex/ext/refine/CardAsk.js:45`, so this is a catch-up and the line is accurate. `SessionFolders.test.mjs` exists, but I did not check whether it covers `url`/`url_in`.

`doc/completion.md` and the `core/Task/readme.md` "No silent endings" bullet now say the closing task is filed only when `SERVEX_OPEN_ITEMS=on`, and the dry-run link is fixed. They agree with each other. The timing range "0.4-1.2 s" replaces "0.5-0.7 s", which is fine as a re-measure, but no measuring command is cited.
The diff has no UI change, so there are no shots and no Words or layout questions to answer. The readme edits are plain and carry no dated logs.

The named brief `mastermind-session-truth/requirements.md` does not exist (the briefs sit one level down, e.g. `truth/requirements.md`), and the diff matches none of them: it is a small tally fix, not the truth page or the twin fold. A fresh agent cannot tell which ask this diff answers; add a requirements.md (or a task line) at the folder root that names it.

`core/Task/Task.js:390` counts a task with `no_action` as `finished` but never runs `Task.proof_problem` on it, and `core/Task/readme.md` (the `tally()` line, "counts created/finished/stopped/open") and `doc/completion.md` do not say that a `no_action` turn now lands in `finished`. Add one sentence to the readme's `tally()` description so the counts are explained where they are defined.

The code change is correct and tested: `completion.test.mjs` (new `s4c` case) and `Session.test.mjs:133` both assert `tally().open === 0` after `no_action`. It reads `k.no_action` as a plain field, which works because Item assigns unknown keys, but there is no declared getter in `Task.js`.

`Session/readme.md:39` now documents `url(id)` and `url_in(repo, id)`, which match `SessionFolders.mjs:173,179` and are tested at `SessionFolders.test.mjs:77-84`. The `completion.md` edits (switch-on wording, 0.4-1.2 s timing) are accurate and consistent with `Task/readme.md`.
The diff has no UI, so the `shots/` folder in the task folder is unrelated to it and nothing in `shots/` can show this change.
